content.title: Leatt Reports Q3 Revenue Growth Amid Market Challenges
content.summary: Leatt ( (LEAT) ) has shared an announcement. Leatt Corporation reported a modest growth in global revenues for Q3 2024, with a 1% increase, reaching $12.14 million. Despite a 75% drop in net income, the company saw a significant rise in direct-to-consumer sales by 12% and improved cash flow and liquidity.
